blocks.text: Seismometer aisa instrument (auzaar) hai jo zameen ke neeche rocks (chattanon) ki har motion (chalna ya hilna), ya zalzale, volcano (aatish-fishan) phatne aur dhamake se paida hone wali vibration (kaanpna) ko detect (mehsoos) karta hai. Seismometer electromagnetic induction se zameen ki motion ko electrical signals mein badal kar zalzale ka pata lagata hai. Aam taur par is mein spring se latka ek weight (wazan) hota hai. Zalzale mein zameen hilti hai magar wazan inertia (apni halat qaim rakhne ki aadat) ki wajah se taqreeban stationary (ruka hua) rehta hai. Is se wazan aur zameen se jure frame ke darmiyan relative (ek doosre ke lehaz se) motion hoti hai. Aksar wazan ke saath magnet laga hota hai jo taar ki coil ke andar hilta hai (Fig. 10.19). Yeh Faraday ke electromagnetic induction ke law (qaida) par kaam karta hai: coil se badalta magnetic flux coil mein emf paida karta hai, aur is se induced current behta hai.

blocks.alt: Base plate par stand aur oopar wala bazu (arm). Bazu se spring par cylinder jaisa wazan latka hai; wazan se nikli stylus (nok) khaanon wale recording drum ko chhooti hai, jis par surkh wavy line bani hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.19: Seismometer (kitab ki Figure 10.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Zameen hile to stand aur drum us ke saath hilte hain, magar spring par latka wazan apne inertia ki wajah se taqreeban stationary rehta hai. Is relative motion se drum par wavy line banti hai. Text ke mutabiq wazan ke saath magnet coil ke andar hilta hai; badalta flux emf aur current paida karta hai jo record hota hai.

Induced current zameen ki motion ki velocity ke proportional hota hai. Paida hone wale electrical signals ko barha (amplify) kar record kiya jata hai. Is se zalzale ki waves ka amplitude, frequency aur duration (kitni der) maloom hoti hai. Is information ka analysis (baarik jaanch) kar ke zalzale ki jagah (location), magnitude (zalzale ki taqat) aur depth (gehrai) nikali jati hai.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Zyada tar zalzale plate tectonics (zameen ki plates ke sarakne) se aate hain; kitab ke mutabiq yeh taqreeban 60 km gehrai par hote hain aur shallow (kam gehre) kehlate hain. Intermediate zalzale crust ke neeche 280 km tak gehre ho sakte hain, aur deep zalzale 280 km se bhi neeche tak ja sakte hain. (Aam taur par shallow taqreeban 70 km tak, intermediate 70 se 300 km aur deep 300 se 700 km gine jate hain.)

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Seismic waves do khaas qism ki hain: P-waves (primary waves) longitudinal hoti hain, yani particles (nanhe tukre) wave (maoj) ki direction (rukh) mein aage peeche hilte hain; S-waves (secondary waves) transverse hoti hain, yani particles wave ki direction ke perpendicular hilte hain. (Yeh waves zalzale se paida hoti hain.)

Aam taur par seismometer zameen ke neeche 50 se 1000 metre gehrai par bury (dafan) kiya jata hai. Use ek protective (hifazati) dabbe mein rakhte hain jise vault kehte hain: taqreeban 1 metre chaura aur 2 metre gehra cylinder-numa steel tank, jis ki tah mein concrete ka pad hota hai (Fig. 10.20).

blocks.alt: Not to scale khaaka. Zameen mein zalzale ke focus se circles phailte hain; lehar ki line neeche vault ke seismic instruments tak jati hai. Vault ke oopar mast par GPS antenna aur Suraj ki roshni wala solar panel hai, aur dashed line data computer tak le jati hai. Labels: Not to scale!, Earthquake, Solar energy charges the batteries, GPS communicate with the satellites for location, Seismic equipment in vault transmits data to computer, Computer stores the data.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.20: Seismometer station: vault mein instruments (auzaar), solar bijli, GPS aur computer (not to scale) (kitab ki Figure 10.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 10.20 ke labels mein do ghaltiyan chhapi hain: 'Solar energy changes the batteries' aur 'GPS communicate with the cities for location'. Sahi yeh hai ke solar energy batteries ko charge karti hai, aur GPS receiver satellites se rabta kar ke jagah (location) maloom karta hai; khaake mein yahi sahi alfaaz likhe hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Zalzale ki waves centre (focus) se har taraf phailti hain aur vault mein rakhe seismometer tak pohanchti hain. Seismometer unhein electrical signal mein badal kar computer ko bhejta hai, solar panel batteries charge karta hai aur GPS jagah batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Spring se latka magnet galvanometer se jure coil ke andar bahar jhoolta hai. Galvanometer kya dikhata hai (MCQ 10.10)? Sensitive (hassas) instrument ko stray (bhatakti) magnetic fields se bachane ke liye aap kya karenge (constructed response 10.9)?
blocks.explanation: Magnet andar aaye to coil se flux barhta hai aur bahar jaye to ghatta hai, is liye galvanometer ki sui baen daen jhoolti hai; Lenz ke law se induced currents motion ko oppose karte aur energy lete hain, is liye jhoolna aur sui ka hilna dheere dheere khatam ho jata hai: option (d). Instrument ko soft iron (naram loha) ya kisi aur zyada permeability wale material ke dabbe mein band karein; yeh bahar ki field lines ko apne andar se guzar deta hai aur dabbe ke andar field bohat kam reh jati hai.

items: Seismometer: frame par coil ke andar spring par magnet; zameen aur coil hilte hain, magnet inertia se stationary rehta hai, badalta flux emf induce karta hai (Faraday ka law); induced current zameen ki velocity ke proportional; barha kar record karne se location, magnitude aur depth.
50 se 1000 m neeche vault (taqreeban 1 m chaura, 2 m gehra steel tank) mein dafan; P-waves longitudinal, S-waves transverse; zyada tar zalzale plate tectonics se.
